text: ここを　ぶじに　ぬければ　してんのうに　あえるぞ！

structure.jp: ここを　ぶじに　ぬければ
structure.en: if you get through here safely

structure.jp: してんのうに　あえるぞ！
structure.en: you can meet the Elite Four!

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: The えば ending means 'if', giving the condition for what follows. ぬければ = 'if you get through'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing the verb's ending to the e-sound plus る says 'can do'. あう 'meet' becomes あえる. あえるぞ = 'you can meet them!'

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is rough, manly talk that gives a statement extra punch. あえるぞ = 'you can meet them, I tell you!'
